violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: During the walk, the hose was on the ground and laid out on the playground where children could access it.

finding_variants.text: During the walk, the hose was on the ground and laid out on the playground where children could access it.
The operation has a water hose on the toddler s playground and is accessible to the children.      Note: This was corrected when the director stored the water hose away.
The water hose was left out on the ground in the playground.
During the walkthrough I observed a waterhose on the ground. This was not corrected due to the operation not being able to remove the hose from the water main line in the wall.
During a DFPS visit the water pad and water hose were observed to be out. The mat had not been sanitized, and the hose was posing a tripping hazard.
A water hose was observed across the playground. This was corrected during the inspection.
